tools.name: create_game
tools.description: Create a new game on the creator's account and open its first build round. Accepts Authorization: Bearer (creator key or OAuth access). tools.name: open_round
tools.description: Open a new post-publish improvement round on a published game. Accepts Authorization: Bearer (creator key or OAuth access) + slug. Spends the same daily improvement quota as Studio. Returns jobId only — call start() next for a sessionKey. Idempotent while a round is already open.

tools.name: continue_draft
